text:
The walnut tree’s shadow is dangerous

Dense in October like a vault,
like an unmoving dome,
it shelters us and invites us
to its cool caress
and fruits fall one by one,
tortured brains, walnuts, walnuts


At night
shadow of dead moon from the walnut tree
and its plaintive leaves
kill themselves one by one
and unknown, invisible feet
tread them down, crush and bury them,
thus freeing them
from the windy whirlwind
that lashes what is mortal, abandoned
on the earth’s grim surface,
impenetrable


But who passes, who pauses?
Whose are those merciful, redeeming feet?

translation.title: The Walnut Tree’s Shadow
